title: Reject mislabeled base quantities in warehouse transfer drafts and posting
description: Close warehouse transfer unit corruption: StockTransferPostingRules.EnsureLiveMasterDataAsync checks product existence/status only. Approve resolves product then overwrites d.Unit with product.Unit while posting unchanged d.Quantity and UnitCost to both warehouses. A quantity labeled CTN or KG can silently become PCS. Existing flow has no package conversion; enforce base-unit eligibility instead of inventing conversion or cost changes. Reuse existing rule/controller and maintain two-warehouse conservation, application lock and deterministic stock locks. No StockUnitConversion edit or new alternate posting route. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Create/update validate explicitly supplied detail units against the live product base unit before numbering, tracked replacement or persistence. This flow already measures quantities in base units: reject nonempty package/arbitrary units without converting quantities or costs; retain documented blank-unit fallback, trimmed case-insensitive base input and server-owned identities. A nonempty unit with missing base configuration fails controlled.

Submit/approve recheck stored effective units inside existing document/inventory locks before status or ledger mutation. Preserve permission checks, current inventory baseline and cost/quantity rules, source semantics and atomicity. Invalid requests change no document/detail/status/number/stock/movement. Historical read and reversal semantics remain available without newly introduced eligibility gates.

Meaningful unit/controller plus genuine isolated SQL exercise base/blank/case/whitespace, package and arbitrary invalid labels, edited product base before commitment, rollback and unchanged balances/audit, existing concurrency/posting/reversal regressions. Safe Release/full units required; record actual environment and full unique logs, no phase acceptance claim.
implementation_evidence: Source verified: StockTransferController:274-294 overwrites unit before unchanged quantity ledger writes; master helper product check contains no unit test. ERP-501 line precision and ERP-354 atomic posting cover different risks; task/title history and docs/backlog have no transfer unit guard.
